snippet.title: New game trailer: Dust storms threaten your sustainable moon town
snippet.description:
New trailer for my cozy sci-fi farm/life sim video game, Cave Oasis at Shylake! You arrive in town to be the new greenhouse farmer, right when dust storms start to appear on the moon’s surface, threatening to block out the town’s precious sunlight. You’ll help the town grow and craft supplies, build energy tech and wildlife protections, diagnose environmental problems and develop solutions, to support the ecosystem and community.

Demo out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3689220/Cave_Oasis_at_Shylake/
